replies.body: Fixed in d470a4dc. Stored function-call responses now use IDs derived from the sorted request JSON, so distinct requests no longer overwrite each other while identical requests remain deterministic. Added regression cases that create responses with different tools, models, or inputs before retrieving both.

threads.body: The background-stream storage exception is bypassed when the response requests a function call. For example, `{"input":"weather?","tools":[{"type":"function","name":"get_weather"}],"background":true,"stream":true,"store":false}` reaches this return without storing or registering the response: create returns JSON, retrieval loses the tools, and resumption returns 400. Apply the background-stream finalization here too, and cover a first-turn function call rather than only inputs where the tool has already been called.
